rig.name: Pink Floyd - One Of These Days - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from heavy fuzz/distortion.
Drive the signal into the fuzz and boost midrange presence for nasal tone.
blocks.gap: Using Boost to simulate a pre-amp drive stage before the main distortion.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core fuzzed bass texture and aggressive saturation.
Simulate the punchy, slightly aggressive British tone suitable for psychedelic rock.
blocks.gap: The UK 800 is chosen for its mid-range focus and ability to handle heavy fuzz without sounding overly scooped.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet sound that complements the UK 800 amp model.
Enhance the nasal midrange and cut excessive low-end rumble from the fuzz.
Create the signature Binson Echorec/tape echo effect required for the psychedelic texture.
Provide a subtle sense of space and gated sustain texture without sounding ambient.
blocks.gap: Using Room reverb for controlled decay rather than the full wash of Plate/Spring.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic 1970s psychedelic studio sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage British cab IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback or similar)
proposals.reason: Enhance the vintage, slightly scooped 70s studio tone and complement the fuzz/UK amp.
